## What's new in 0.3.3

- **Downloads:** fixed downloads failing straight away with a "closed" message in 0.3.2. Downloads use the same requests as before 0.3.2 again, keep the fix that stopped mobile data from pausing them, and now retry unexpected errors (with fresh links) instead of giving up.
- **Download dialog:** calmer, smaller text for the format lists and the video title.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog).
